newsitem.title: INDIA: 14 killed in India as bus crashes into ravine.
newsitem.headline: 14 killed in India as bus crashes into ravine.

text.p: At least 14 people were killed and 11 injured in northern India on Sunday when a passenger bus skidded off a road and crashed into a deep ravine, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.
The news agency said the accident took place near Dharmari, 115 km (70 miles) from Jammu, the winter capital of the northern state of Jammu and Kashmir.
